preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**9 for N in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case contains a single integer N between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of results matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result < 10**9 + 7 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
